Use a Project Alternative or tempo set and document the current Project Tempo mode, region Smart Tempo/Flex & Follow state, map, downbeat, and meter before editing.
The BPM or tempo-map change barely affected what I hear.
Explain what the null result rules out, verify downbeat/meter/source authority, and choose one smaller diagnostic check.
Why did that happen, and what should I learn from it?

Explain the causal principle in plain language and connect it to the exact A/B: MIDI always follows project tempo during playback, but Smart Tempo can analyze note timing to derive a map from a free performance. The result still needs beat and downbeat validation.
